propositions: Copilot, Codex, and Claude clients must be configured to connect to the rebar MCP HTTP endpoint using static bearer token authentication sourced from environment variables.
Example client configurations must be committed to examples/mcp-clients/ with env-var references for bearer tokens, never inline PAT literals, and verified against each client's documented schema.

A hermetic test suite must validate real tool results (e.g., ticket list/show) over a loopback rebar-mcp HTTP instance with resolved bearer tokens and confirm 401 rejection for absent/invalid credentials.

Per-client CLI acceptance checks (copilot mcp get, codex mcp list, claude mcp list) must load and validate the committed example configs where the client binary is installed, with skip-with-reason for absent binaries.
Setup documentation must link to existing avians runbook and template, defining only the missing per-client config shapes and gotchas (e.g., static header does not fall back to OAuth on rejection).
